instruction: In column D, starting at row 2, write the first word from each movie title listed in 'Garbage Movie titles'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting the first word from each of the 28 movie titles in column B and placing them in column D starting from row 2. Verified with Python: there are 28 titles total. The custom getter reads BOTH column B (source titles) and column D (extracted words), then verifies each entry in D is the correct first word from the corresponding title in B. The metric awards score based on both quantity (>=28 entries) and quality (correctness of extraction).
metadata.verification: Verified with Python: There are 28 movie titles in column B (rows 2-29). The task extracts first words from each title. Expected first words include: MiniONs, THE, hAiry, enemy, SileNcE, etc. (28 total). Evaluator verifies both that entries exist in column D AND that each entry correctly matches the first word from the corresponding movie title in column B.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Score combines correctness and count: 70% weight on correctness ratio (correct_count/total_count) and 30% weight on count ratio (min(total_count/28, 1.0)). Full score (1.0) requires all 28 first words correctly extracted.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads BOTH column B (source titles) and column D (extracted words) to verify extraction correctness (xlsx.py:56-86).
Getter implements proper extraction verification logic: splits each title in column B by whitespace, extracts first word, and compares against corresponding value in column D (xlsx.py:72-84).
Metric properly evaluates both quality (correctness ratio) and quantity (count ratio) with appropriate weighting: 70% correctness + 30% count (xlsx.py:29-38).
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies all 28 movie titles by iterating through rows until source column is empty (xlsx.py:57-68).
Appropriate comparison: Uses case-sensitive exact match which is correct for movie titles with mixed case (e.g., 'MiniONs', 'hAiry').
Postconfig properly saves the file with Ctrl+S to ensure state persistence before verification (evaluator.postconfig lines 45-54).
Edge cases handled: Returns zero counts if file cannot be retrieved, handles empty cells correctly (xlsx.py:34-35, 67-68).
